Name: Vibrance Sap
Description: A burst of energy in the shape of a lesser yokai fires at one target within range as a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 2d8 necrotic damage and must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the target can take either an action or a bonus action on their next turn, but not both.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, its damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot above the 1st. If cast at 5th level or higher, the creature can only make 1 weapon attack on their next turn if they fail the Constitution saving throw regardless of their features or magic items.
Sourcebook: Lyres Guide to Retia - Land of Industry
